# v38.0 Guard: Spanish/Iberian colonial viceroyalties (e.g. 1648 VNS) MUST achieve independence before forming sovereign Mexico (MEX).
REPLACE:MEX_f = {
	level = 3
	required_locations_fraction = 0.5
	rule = historical
	capital_required = yes
	potential = {
		OR = {
			any_primary_or_accepted_or_tolerated_culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:iberian_group }
			religion.group = religion_group:christian
		}
	}
	allow = {
		is_subject = no
		OR = {
			culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:iberian_group }
			AND = {
				culture = { is_culture_native_american = yes }
				religion.group = religion_group:christian
			}
		}
	}
	name = MEX
	flag = MEX
	adjective = MEX_ADJ
	tag = MEX
	color = map_MEX
	regions = {
		mesoamerica_region
	}
	form_effect = {
		remove_variable = oe_col4_named
	}
}
